leairn.title: leAIrn
leairn.description: A gamified learning platform for mastering AI prompting — like Duolingo, but for prompts. Features 6 exercise types, AI-powered evaluation via Groq, full gamification (XP, streaks, badges, leaderboard), social features, and Stripe-based freemium/pro subscriptions.

nali.title: Nali
nali.description: A modern SaaS alternative to Jira/Linear, built for dev teams. Includes multi-org management, Kanban boards with sprints, real-time messaging, AES-256 encrypted documents, GitHub integration, WebRTC video calls, and Stripe billing with 4 plans.

reflexion.title: scraping-polymarket
reflexion.description: An autonomous predictive trading bot that scrapes multi-source data (Polymarket, Google News, Reddit, CoinGecko), analyzes prediction markets via a local LLM (Qwen 2.5 7B) using a superforecaster methodology, and generates calibrated predictions with paper trading.

minishell.title: Minishell
minishell.description: minishell is a minimalist Unix command interpreter implemented in C as part of the 42 Common Core. The goal is to replicate basic shell behavior similar to Bash, handling command execution, input/output redirections, pipes, environment variables, and keyboard signals. The project focuses on process management, file descriptor manipulation, and user input handling while adhering to project constraints and ensuring no memory leaks.

irc.title: IRC
irc.description: ft_irc is a custom implementation of an IRC (Internet Relay Chat) server developed in C++ as part of the 42 Common Core. The project focuses on network protocol fundamentals by building a server that handles multiple clients concurrently, authenticates users, manages channels, and facilitates public and private messaging. The server uses non-blocking TCP sockets and adheres to IRC protocol specifications, enabling real-time communication between clients through standard commands such as NICK, USER, JOIN, PART, and PRIVMSG. This project deepens understanding of network programming, event handling, and communication protocols.

transcendence.title: Transcendence
transcendence.description: transcendence is an interactive full-stack web application developed as part of the final project of the 42 Common Core. It enables users to authenticate, manage their profiles, and play a real-time online version of Pong against other players. The application also includes social features such as chat, game statistics, and match history. The project uses a modern architecture with a backend API, WebSockets for real-time gameplay, a database for persistence, and a responsive frontend for a smooth and engaging user experience.

music_room.title: Music_Room
music_room.description: Music Room is an innovative application that makes it easy for friends and music enthusiasts to discover and share music. Users can create and manage playlists, join music events, vote for their favorite tracks, and customize their profiles based on their preferences. The project is built on a high-performance API using Node.js and Prisma, along with an intuitive React Native mobile app with expo. Music Room encourages social interaction and offers a rich, personalized music experience.

matcha.title: Matcha
matcha.description: Matcha is a social dating application. It allows users to create profiles, browse other profiles, send messages, and find matches based on shared interests. The application incorporates features such as geolocation, user preferences, and a real-time notification system. The project implements a full-stack architecture with a backend API, a database for user management, and an interactive frontend for an engaging user experience.
